title: Buy more than a stack in one go
summary: Alt+click an item at a vendor, type any amount, and VendorPrinter makes the purchases for you: 193 becomes 9 x 20 + 1 x 13.

steps.say: At a vendor, one purchase is capped at a stack: 20 Mild Spices at most.
It shows the total price and how many purchases that takes.
Click Buy and it makes them one after another, with a progress bar.
193 Mild Spices in 10 purchases. It stops by itself if the vendor runs out, your money runs out or your bags fill up.
